name: Mandarin Oriental, Barcelona
positioning: Urban luxury hotel on Passeig de Gràcia in Barcelona's Eixample, with interiors by designer Patricia Urquiola
best_for: Travelers who want a central Barcelona base on Passeig de Gràcia
Food-focused travelers drawn to the Michelin-starred restaurant Moments

facts.text: Mandarin Oriental, Barcelona is located at Pg. de Gràcia, 38-40, Eixample, 08007 Barcelona, Spain.
The hotel is described as an urban oasis in the heart of Barcelona's Golden Square.
The hotel has contemporary interiors by designer Patricia Urquiola.
Moments is the Michelin-starred restaurant at the heart of Mandarin Oriental, Barcelona.
Moments is helmed by chef Raül Balam.
Carme Ruscalleda is the gastronomic adviser at Moments.
Blanc is the elegant all-day dining restaurant at Mandarin Oriental, Barcelona.
Blanc is set beneath a luminous glass atrium.
On Sundays, Blanc offers a brunch.
The spa facilities include a steam room, a heated indoor pool and a relaxation area.
The Fitness Centre is equipped with Technogym equipment.

highlights.text: Deluxe Boulevard Rooms overlook the iconic Manzana de la Discordia.
Moments was designed by Patricia Urquiola, with an open window to the kitchen.
Mimosa Garden is a garden terrace in the heart of Barcelona.
The hotel offers free and secure self-parking for guests arriving in personal vehicles.
The Family Suite is an apartment style two-bedroom suite designed with families in mind.

considerations.text: Seasonally, the rooftop Terrat and Mimosa Garden specialise in cocktails, beverages and light Mediterranean cuisine.
Reservations are recommended at the hotel's restaurants, particularly for the Michelin-starred Moments.
Moments welcomes children from the age of 5 and above.
The minimum age requirement for access to the spa and fitness center is 18 years of age.
WhataHotel notes the hotel is on a busy shopping street, with potential traffic noise.
